name: arqueia
description: Plataforma integrada de gestão, rastreabilidade e compartilhamento de infraestrutura laboratorial.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @arqueia/config && npm run build --workspace @arqueia/contracts && npm run build --workspace @arqueia/database && npm run build --workspace @arqueia/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @arqueia/api && npm run build --workspace @arqueia/web && npm run build --workspace @arqueia/worker
scripts.dev: echo "Use os scripts dev de cada app (apps/web, apps/api, apps/worker)"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
